title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A retired outlaw and sharpshooter who sees through illusions with her golden eye and joins Oko's crew to stop Akul.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A fae planeswalker and shapeshifting trickster who leads the crew in a heist on the vault of Maag Taranau and learns he has a son.

entities.name: Fortune
entities.description: Annie's magical horse companion, summoned to her by their bond.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A furry blue goblin on Oko's crew who specializes in explosives and brews potions.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A winged siren on Oko's crew who does surveillance.

entities.name: Tinybones
entities.description: A small, mischievous skeleton thief on Oko's crew who can disassemble himself.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A necromancer on Oko's crew and Geralf's sibling.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A necromancer on Oko's crew who serves as the team's medic, and Gisa's sibling.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch who specializes in charms and helps free the prisoners.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon assassin from Ravnica and Oko's second-in-command, whom Ral believed dead.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who deals in nightmares and who hired the crew to break into the vault of Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A giant four-horned demon too large to fit through doors, who is on Oko's crew.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A fire-wielding warlock and would-be conqueror held in the Sterling Company prison.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: A thief held in the Sterling Company prison who has shifting tattoos and helps Oko open the safe.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who works with the Sterling Company and is stunned to see Vraska alive.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young fae and Ral's bodyguard who reveals to Oko that he is his son and helps him escape.

entities.name: Alyse
entities.description: Kellan's mother, whom Oko remembers fondly.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: The dragon leader of the Hellspurs who built the town of Tarnation around the vault.

entities.name: Bertram Graywater
entities.description: The founder of the Sterling Company, who possesses the key to Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Annie's nephew
entities.description: A nephew harmed by Akul, Annie's reason to oppose him.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: A legendary vault, the only structure on Thunder Junction said to predate the Omenpaths, believed to hold raw power.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: The town the Hellspurs built around the vault hoping to control it.

entities.name: Rustwood
entities.description: A failed ranching town containing the Wildcard Saloon, where Oko's crew meets.

entities.name: The Wildcard Saloon
entities.description: The saloon in Rustwood that serves as the crew's hideout.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: A powerful company on Thunder Junction with headquarters and a prison in Prosperity.

entities.name: Sterling Company headquarters
entities.description: The fortified headquarters and prison at the edge of Prosperity.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: Akul's outlaw gang.

entities.name: Prosperity
entities.description: The bustling metropolis on Thunder Junction where the Sterling Company is headquartered.

entities.name: The sixth key
entities.description: A small, otherworldly artifact of blackened metal and fluorescent parts, one of the keys to the vault.

entities.name: Thunder rifle
entities.description: Annie's rifle, which she digs up from a hidden grave.

entities.name: Saddlebrush
entities.description: Annie's home town, which she fears Akul might attack.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The Wild West plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Omenport
entities.description: The town where people come searching for the vault.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Vraska's home plane.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Portals between planes on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Oko's crew
entities.description: The team of thieves, witches, necromancers and assassins Oko assembles to rob the vault of Maag Taranau.

events.summary: Unable to sleep after Oko's threat to her town, Annie digs up her buried thunder rifle.
events.quote: pulled the lid back to reveal her thunder rifle.

events.summary: Annie summons Fortune and rides to Rustwood following Oko's matchbook.
events.quote: Annie took Oko's matchbook from her pocket and looked at the black lettering once more.

events.summary: Annie meets Breeches, Malcolm and Tinybones at the Wildcard Saloon, where Oko is waiting behind the bar.
events.quote: "Care for a drink?" Oko's voice sounded from behind the bar.

events.summary: Oko introduces the rest of the crew, including Gisa, Geralf, Eriette and Vraska, as his second-in-command.
events.quote: And Vraska—an assassin from Ravnica—is my second-in-command.

events.summary: Annie agrees to join the crew, but only as far as stopping Akul.
events.quote: "I'm in—but only as far as stopping Akul."

events.summary: Oko announces the crew will rob Maag Taranau, a vault Annie thought a myth.
events.quote: "We're going to rob Maag Taranau," he said at last.

events.summary: Ashiok appears and explains they hired the crew to break into the vault, which Akul built the town of Tarnation around.
events.quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built an entire town around the vault hoping to control it.

events.summary: Oko explains that Bertram Graywater holds the key and that the courier Akul chased was a decoy.
events.quote: he had Akul halfway across the desert chasing a decoy courier

events.summary: Oko says the first stop is the Sterling Company headquarters, where two team members are imprisoned and the key is held; Rakdos arrives.
events.quote: Our first stop is the Sterling Company headquarters,

events.summary: Disguised as a courier, Oko enters Sterling Company headquarters carrying a box with Tinybones inside.
events.quote: The moment he stepped over the threshold, Oko surveyed the room.

events.summary: Eriette dissolves a vent grate with Breeches's potion and charms the prison guards while Annie slips past.
events.quote: Eriette stepped forward and whispered a spell under her breath

events.summary: Annie sees through the illusions hiding Kaervek and Umezawa in their cells and Eriette frees them.
events.quote: Kaervek was on one side of the room; Satoru Umezawa was on the other.

events.summary: Tinybones emerges from the box in Graywater's office and Umezawa finds Oko there.
events.quote: Tinybones burst from the lid, partially disassembled.

events.summary: Umezawa and Oko open a hidden safe behind the portrait and take the sixth key.
events.quote: The sixth key.

events.summary: Oko, leaving, meets Ral Zarek and Kellan on the road and senses Kellan's fae magic; his illusion collapses.
events.quote: Oko stiffened, and his illusion faded away without warning

events.summary: Oko and Tinybones knock out Ral's guard and flee, Oko taking eagle form.
events.quote: He shapeshifted into a large eagle

events.summary: Kellan tells Oko he thinks Oko is his father, and that his mother is Alyse.
events.quote: "I think you're my father."

events.summary: Surrounded by Sterling guards, Oko is saved when Kellan throws the guards back with golden vine-shaped magic.
events.quote: Confusion swirled through Oko's mind until he realized the magic was coming from Kellan.

events.summary: Vraska appears and Ral stops, stunned to see her alive; Rakdos knocks Ral aside.
events.quote: Rakdos swung a boulder-size fist into the lightning mage and sent him skidding off into the dust.

events.summary: Oko decides Kellan should join them, announcing that he is his son, over Vraska's objection.
events.quote: Besides, didn't you hear? He's my son.

events.summary: Oko decides having a son could be very useful.
events.quote: Oko decided that having a son could turn out to be very useful indeed.

relations.note: Oko recognizes Kellan as his son by Alyse.
relations.quote: Besides, didn't you hear? He's my son.

relations.note: Oko assembles and directs the heist team.
relations.quote: I'm going to give you the same opportunity I gave everyone else here
And Vraska—an assassin from Ravnica—is my second-in-command.

relations.note: Ashiok hired Oko's crew to break into the vault.
relations.quote: They hired us to break into the vault.

relations.note: Gisa and Geralf are necromancer siblings.
relations.quote: That's Gisa and Geralf, the necromancer siblings.

relations.note: Akul and the Hellspurs built Tarnation around the vault.
relations.quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built an entire town around the vault

relations.note: Graywater is the founder of the Sterling Company.
relations.quote: The founder of the Sterling Company?

relations.note: Annie joins to stop Akul over what he did to her nephew.
relations.quote: I know what Akul did to your nephew.

relations.note: The two prisoners detest each other.
Annie and Fortune share a magical bond.
relations.quote: summoned by the bond between them

relations.note: Kellan acts as Ral's bodyguard until he turns on him.
relations.quote: he'd turned on his own boss to do it

relations.note: Ral believed Vraska was dead and is stunned to see her alive.
